questions.q: What simple daily duration does the book recommend for meditation?
questions.why: The text advises giving only 10-15 minutes a day to meditate.

questions.q: Which posture is described as "seiza" in the book?
a: Sitting in a chair with palms up
questions.why: Seiza is defined as sitting in a chair with hands resting palms up.

questions.q: How does the book differentiate attention from awareness?
a: Attention focuses on one object; awareness monitors everything
Attention monitors everything; awareness focuses on one object
Attention is passive, awareness is active
questions.why: Attention is the ability to focus on a particular thing, whereas awareness is being aware of what's going on around you.

questions.q: What benefit of meditation is highlighted for memory?
questions.why: Meditation is said to have many benefits, including improved focus and memory.

questions.q: What habit comparison is used to illustrate building a meditation routine?
questions.why: Meditation habit is likened to brushing your teeth as a repeated daily task.
